ext.description: Deploy Antigravity IDE remote server & agy AI CLI locally over SSH/SCP, with a secure reverse proxy tunnel for offline/air-gapped hosts.
viewContainer.title: Remote Helper
view.hosts.name: SSH Hosts (Local Deploy + Tunnel)
cmd.deployAndConnectCurrentWindow: Remote Helper: Deploy Server & Connect in Current Window
cmd.deployOnly: Remote Helper: Deploy Server, AGY CLI & Proxy Config
cmd.startTunnelForHost: Remote Helper: Start Reverse Proxy Tunnel
cmd.stopTunnelForHost: Remote Helper: Stop Reverse Proxy Tunnel
cmd.downloadCache: Remote Helper: Download Server Archive to Local Cache
cfg.sshPath: Path to ssh executable. Leave empty to use remote.antigravitySSH.path or ssh from PATH.
cfg.scpPath: Path to scp executable. Leave empty to infer from ssh path or scp from PATH.
cfg.configFile: Path to custom SSH config file. Leave empty to use remote.antigravitySSH.configFile or ~/.ssh/config.
cfg.proxyUrl: Optional upstream HTTP proxy URL on local machine (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7890). Leave empty when your local PC connects directly.
cfg.enableProxyTunnel: Run a local loopback HTTP/HTTPS proxy and forward it over SSH (-R) so AGY AI chat, autocomplete, and extensions work on offline remote hosts.
cfg.enableTerminalProxy: Also inject HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY into Antigravity IDE integrated terminals on the remote host (without modifying ~/.bashrc).
cfg.tunnelPort: Loopback port (127.0.0.1) used on both local PC and remote SSH host for the reverse proxy tunnel.
cfg.deployAgyCli: Also download the remote ~/.gemini/bin/agy backend locally and deploy it over SCP.
cfg.forceRedeploy: Always re-upload and extract server & agy CLI even if binaries already exist on the remote host.
